exposure: conservative treatment (forearm crutches, medical therapy, HBO therapy)
outcome: avascular necrosis (AVN) of the femoral head
cohort: 18 patients (6 females, 12 males) diagnosed with transient osteoporosis of the hip
finding: Conservative treatment, including forearm crutches, medical therapy, and HBO therapy, led to significant clinical and radiological improvements in patients with TOH, with no cases of AVN or therapy-related complications.
mod_finding: Three female patients had a history of cesarean delivery.
